name: Talab Matsyiki Vishesh Sahayata Yojana (Anusuchit Jaati/Janajati/Ati Pichhada)
benefit:
> **Assistance** - Offers a 70% subsidy on the total cost, reducing the financial burden on beneficiaries.
> **Subsidy Payment:** - Subsidy payments are made in two installments: 60% after pond construction and 40% after installation of related units and purchase of inputs.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Castes, Tribes, or Most Backward Classes. 1. The applicant should have private or leased land available for pond construction.
